overall.label: ready_for_local_use
overall.summary: The repository is in a stable enough state for local analysis, public review, and careful contribution.

quickstart.title: Install and preflight
quickstart.why: Checks imports, files, SQLite writeability, public music health, and built artifacts before a local run is treated as dependable.

quickstart.title: Run the live API
quickstart.why: Serves the browser, JSON endpoints, and docs from the same local repository state.

quickstart.title: Bake the static surface
quickstart.why: Regenerates the committed JSON artifacts so the browser can run without the live API.

quickstart.title: Seed the live event window
quickstart.why: Loads the bounded demonstration event batch so the rolling window, contract lane, and WebSocket feed have immediate data to inspect.

adoption_paths.title: Research and strategy teams
adoption_paths.best_for: Inspecting bias, attention concentration, and public narrative pressure without private platform access.

adoption_paths.title: Engineering and data teams
adoption_paths.best_for: Auditing contracts, build parity, static artifacts, runtime shape, and the current boundary between batch analytics and real streaming.

adoption_paths.title: Music, editorial, and market readers
adoption_paths.best_for: Reading public reach, release concentration, channel exposure, and role-based consequences from a separate real-data lane.

commercial_posture.best_fit_today: A public analysis and experimentation surface with a working backend spine. The full streaming control plane remains a later step.
not_claiming_yet: Managed identity, rate limiting, and operational SLOs
next_engineering_moves: Make the batch-first posture explicit in README, API docs, and system surfaces.
Publish a benchmark harness and baseline timings for 10K, 100K, and 1M records.
Add genre-coverage, freshness, and artifact-parity checks to the doctor output.
